headline: Turning export dynamism into productivity, employment and investment, the challenge for the states
summary: A regional sector report expects higher state-level GDP growth rates in most Mexican states for 2027, and calls for export dynamism to be converted into productivity, employment and investment.
why: State-level growth in Mexico affects regional demand, investment flows and the outlook for the national economy.
original_headline: Convertir dinamismo exportador en productividad, empleo e inversión, el reto de los estados
